note: Linux builds through each crate's build-wasm.sh, so the hashes can be rebuilt from source; CI does. The Prime app pins these: new gates are created from the custody-gate hash and name the execution-adapter hash as their caller's code. A deployed build can lag main: each network's record says which build it runs.

execution-adapter.note: The first muxed-address fix (#4), before #6 added the XDR comparison. It refuses a muxed address and passes the XDR of an address as bytes. No gate uses it and no CI check reads this entry.

execution-adapter.why: the build before the no-gate word; this source builds the adapter that, with no gate, vouches for an immediate batch (bf85432c...), which replaces it here
the build before the optional gate; this source builds the adapter whose gate is optional (4985cd12...), which replaces it here
